I need to consider the evidence about the Morecambe and Wise Christmas Special in 1978.

The Morecambe and Wise Christmas specials were famous for featuring celebrity guests. The most famous political appearance was indeed by a former prime minister in the 1978 Christmas Special.

Agent 1 claims "unknown" with very high confidence (0.95), which seems inconsistent - if they were truly uncertain, the confidence should be low.

Agents 2, 3, and 4 all agree on Harold Wilson with reasonably high confidence (0.75-0.83).

Harold Wilson was Prime Minister from 1964-1970 and 1974-1976, so he would have been a "former" prime minister in 1978. He was known for making this memorable appearance on the show, which became one of the most iconic moments in British television history.
